scope: Structural 0.10.0 refactor with no behavior, API, visual or session-format changes; 0.9.x defects ship separately.

stages.verification: Diff all purported duplicate implementations before deleting copies; preserve intentional fallback/coercion differences. Run affected unit/browser paths and the characterization gate.
Exercise selection, element changes, keyboard/focus and Build integration; audit injected dependencies and lazy DOM construction.
Exercise recorded network success, empty results, failed requests, cancellation, import and metadata interactions; audit closure dependencies.

stages.scope: DOM element cache consolidation, split by panel
stages.reason: The 13 failed baseline suites and the five additional Appearance entry points cluster around panel DOM, Looks, focus, layout and controls. Renaming/rebinding caches can silently miss event paths, null/lazy nodes and callbacks that generic captures do not exercise. A large mechanical diff would cross this coverage gap.
stages.bindingInventory: Audit the actual tagged-base declarations per panel before each PR. Distinguish DOM nodes from controllers/state; preserve when each node is created, assigned, replaced and observed. The original count is planning input, not permission for one 44-binding PR.
stages.prRule: One panel per PR, including separate child-popover PRs when their lifecycle differs. Each PR gets its own review and beta soak. Keep listeners, focus behavior and lazy-query timing unchanged.

panelPrPlan.manualVerification: Apply/edit every Look, switch Object/Look and dock tabs, mix Style/Color schemes, reset/Undo/Revert, save/import user references, retain surface overrides and Hydrogen bonds, round-trip sessions/defaults, scroll/collapse disclosures and inspect rendered materials/shadows.
Open with selection tools visible; edit/cancel coordinates, Delete/Copy/Reorder, units, clipboard, stable IDs and undo. Verify hit targets and stacking against the known legacy collision.
Exercise atom/bond selection, presented cue visibility, absolute position drafts, Translate/Rotate drag and operator commits, remapped selections after edits, stacking, focus and the Escape ladder.

panelPrPlan.panel: Each selection child popover (fragment, coordination or metal bonding), separate PRs
panelPrPlan.manualVerification: Create/recreate the targeted popover, open/close/reopen, commit/cancel each option, change selection and scene, verify metal styles/coordination and H restrictions, and check pointer/keyboard focus.

Enter empty/loaded Edit, inspect initial Build/Transform choice, use search and element/entity controls, place atoms/fragments/molecules, cancel previews, switch tools/modes, dock/minimize/reopen and restore saved layouts.
Open/reopen, change tolerance and candidates, preview elements, cancel/apply/undo, replace the structure and switch modes; preserve Workbench state and legacy close behavior.

panelPrPlan.panel: Each shared canvas/menu/help shell, separate PRs
panelPrPlan.manualVerification: Check menu focus/return, roving radios, outside-click and Escape precedence, pending recovery panels, Focus, responsive placement and viewport hit testing. Shared helpers must be checked against every consuming panel.

commonManualMatrix.modes: All four Workbench modes and all applicable legacy modes
commonManualMatrix.prEvidence: Name each affected failing suite, execute its manual workflows on the tagged base and proposed change, and link results/artifacts. Report failures and remaining defects explicitly; pinned characterization alone is insufficient.

stages.risk: high feature coupling, second to Stage 4 for manual verification
stages.scope: Trajectory, symmetry and vibration state/wiring, one feature per PR
stages.verification: Audit dependency seams, exercise all moved controls and cancellation paths, playback/video/session preservation, and use the affected panel manual matrix. Preserve per-feature beta soak.

knownDefectConstraints.projection: https://github.com/evangelistalab/vibemol/issues/3; camera pin masks the 0.9.x defect, so ordinary preset batches need separate verification.
knownDefectConstraints.axisGizmo: Preserve the 0.9.2/0.9.3 capture-phase Escape ladder: menu/field precedence, cancel provisional placement, disarm Build without dropping selection, clear Transform selection, then allow Focus/panel dismissal. Repair focus handoff without removing interception.
